note: The enquiry form stage 09 places in a blueprint's form slot (fill "site"). While status is "not-connected" the form is laid out but disabled and has no action; stage 11 blocks release until it is "connected" and a real POST to the endpoint has been tested. The endpoint is the first-party API on the same origin (Nginx proxies /api/). Consent links to the privacy page; the honeypot field is hidden from people and left empty by them.
